name: Biodroid
description: (Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:tech+)(Tag:tinker+)(Tech) Race Change - You are a Biodroid, a seamless merging of technology and flesh. You gain increased physical abilities, increased energy reserves, and a natural healing factor. You gain increased affinity for Tinker abilities and machines, and you can converse and interface with machines.
